references.text: Joseph is brought to Egypt and sold to Potiphar, a direct continuation of Gen 37:36 with almost identical wording.
The psalm mentions that Joseph was sent ahead of them and sold as a slave – a poetic summary of the event where Joseph was sold into Egypt.
In Stephen's speech it is mentioned that the patriarchs sold Joseph to Egypt out of jealousy, a direct reference to the sale of Joseph.
The Midianites pulled Joseph out of the well and sold him to the Ishmaelites for twenty silver pieces – the immediate prehistory of the sale into Egypt.
